notes: Wrong sector in our records: this is a medical tourism and medical concierge facilitator (patients from Tanzania to hospitals in India), not a leisure tourism employer. The site is built by script: read_page and WebFetch return only the page shell (title and meta description). The page text was read from the site's own script bundle (https://aafrinmedihealth.com/assets/index-CN3aQvob.js, allowed by robots.txt) and matched to routes: /about renders the Our Team section; / and /contact render the Our Offices section. A browser check by the coordinator would confirm the rendered text. The Arusha link is a registered address in Njiro Industrial Area; the office address is in Dar es Salaam and there is a branch in Mumbai, so check whether any staff work in Arusha. The page's structured data (JSON-LD) gives Dar es Salaam, foundingDate 2020 and numberOfEmployees 10-50 beside a placeholder phone number, and conflicts with the site's 'Established in 2023', so it was not used. No hook: no published workforce size, staff-welfare, education or community programme, and the Arusha presence is only a registered address. The About page also carries the founder's personal and family story, and the contact section lists email addresses; neither was recorded.
